title: Odoo Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 The Odoo Developer will be responsible for developing, customizing, integrating, and maintaining Odoo\-based applications and business solutions. The role involves working across standard Odoo functionality and custom development to deliver scalable solutions aligned with business requirements.
 



  





 The position requires a combination of technical Odoo expertise, problem\-solving ability, understanding of business workflows, and strong software development practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, customize, and maintain Odoo applications and modules based on defined business and technical requirements.
* Analyze requirements and determine the appropriate approach using standard Odoo functionality, configuration, customization, or new development.
* Develop scalable and maintainable custom modules while following Odoo development and coding standards.
* Configure and automate business workflows, approvals, notifications, scheduled activities, and repetitive processes within Odoo.
* Develop and maintain API integrations and data synchronization between Odoo and third\-party applications.
* Develop custom reports, dashboards, analytical views, and business intelligence outputs based on operational requirements.
* Support Odoo version upgrades, including migration and compatibility of custom modules and integrations.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Project Managers, Solution Architects, QA teams, and other developers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Prepare technical approaches, estimates, development plans, and low\-level technical requirements where required.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve development productivity, debugging, testing, documentation, and code quality.
* Provide technical support for deployed Odoo solutions and ensure issues are analyzed and resolved within defined timelines.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Odoo products, solutions, development processes, and delivery practices.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Strong proficiency in Python and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Strong understanding of the Odoo framework, architecture, ORM, models, domains, contexts, actions, and module structure.
* Hands\-on experience developing and customizing Odoo modules.
* Good understanding of Odoo core data models and standard functionality across areas such as CRM, Sales, Purchase, Accounting, Inventory, Projects, Timesheets, HR, and Helpdesk.
* Experience in extending standard Odoo modules using inheritance and custom business logic.
* Experience developing custom models, fields, workflows, wizards, server actions, scheduled actions, automated actions, and business rules.
* Strong experience with XML and Odoo view customization, including Form, List/Tree, Kanban, Search, Pivot, Graph, and QWeb views.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript and Odoo frontend framework for UI and functional customizations.
* Good knowledge of PostgreSQL, relational database concepts, and SQL queries.
* Strong understanding of Odoo security, including users, groups, access control lists, record rules, and role\-based permissions.
* Experience configuring and developing business workflows and process automation across Odoo.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML, webhooks, authentication, and third\-party API integrations.
* Ability to develop or consume APIs for integration with external applications, platforms, and services.
* Experience developing custom dashboards, analytical views, KPIs, and management reports.
* Good debugging and troubleshooting skills across Python, XML, JavaScript, ORM, database, and integration layers.
* Knowledge of Git and source code management, including branching, merging, code reviews, and maintaining development standards.
* Understanding of application performance optimization, database optimization, and scalable Odoo development practices.
* Familiarity with Docker/containerized environments and Odoo deployment processes is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted coding tools and LLM\-based development workflows for coding, debugging, documentation, testing, and productivity is a plus.

title: Senior Golang Engineer - Observability Preferred
description:
**Role \- Senior Golang Engineer \- Observability Preferred** 




**Experience: 3\+ Years** 




**Location: Ahmedabad** 




  





**Position Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for a systems\-minded developer with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience who is comfortable
 



 working close to the machine in Go/Rust, and equally comfortable reasoning about distributed behavior
 



 across a cloud\-native deployment. The ideal candidate has worked in the observability domain — metrics,
 



 logs, traces, time\-series storage and enjoys owning a module end to end. This is a high\-ownership role in a
 



 small, fast\-moving team. You will work across multiple modules, make design calls, use AI\-assisted
 



 development as a daily tool, and be accountable for what you ship in production.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibility:** 




  





**•** 
 Build and scale services for operational data ingestion, enrichment, storage, and query in a
 



 multitenant SaaS environment — spanning push\-based telemetry (metrics, logs, traces), polland protocol\-based collection (SNMP, WMI, SSH, ICMP), event streams (traps, syslog, flow), and
 



 discovery and inventory data.
 



 • Work with event/message\-driven pipelines (NATS) and time\-series, relational, and cache
 



 stores.
 



 • Design ingestion paths that handle heterogeneous sources and cadences — high\-volume
 



 streaming, scheduled polling cycles, bursty event traffic, and transactional API writes — each
 



 with different latency, ordering, and backpressure characteristics.
 



 • Normalize collected data into a common internal model, applying OpenTelemetry semantic
 



 conventions where they fit and defining consistent conventions where they don't, so
 



 downstream consumers see one shape regardless of source.
 



 • Build the data substrate for anomaly and signal detection — streaming aggregation, rollingwindow state, baselining, and correlation across metrics, logs, and traces — and integrate
 



 model inference into the ingestion and query path within latency and resource budgets.
 



 Own system design for your modules — write and defend design notes covering data
 



 model, interfaces, scaling limits, failure modes, and rollback.
 



 • Debug production problems end to end — reproduce, isolate, instrument, and fix issues
 



 including performance regressions and platform\-specific behavior.
 



 • Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of the normal development loop,
 



 while retaining full ownership of correctness, security, and design quality of the generated
 



 output.
 



 • Write clean, testable, well\-instrumented code, participate in code reviews, and contribute
 



 to design and engineering documentation.
 



 • Collaborate with product managers, and fellow engineers to deliver high\-quality features.
 



 • Continuously learn and apply modern development practices and tools.
 



  





**Skills and Qualifications:** 




  





**•** 
 B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT
 



 • Minimum 3 years of hands\-on backend engineering, with production\-level proficiency in Go and the
 



 ability and appetite to work in Rust.
 



 • Demonstrable experience in the observability domain: metrics, logs, traces, agents, collectors,
 



 monitoring systems, or telemetry pipelines.
 



 • Working knowledge of cloud and distributed systems — containers, Kubernetes, service\-to\-service
 



 communication, and the standard distributed failure modes (partial failure, backpressure, retries,
 



 idempotency).
 



 • Strong debugging and production problem\-solving ability using profilers, tracing, logs, and metrics.
 



 • Experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus or similar observability infrastructure.
 



 • Strong reasoning and first\-principles problem\-solving — the ability to break down an unfamiliar
 



 problem, form a hypothesis, and test it, rather than pattern\-matching to a previous solution.
 



 • Adaptive mindset — comfortable with changing priorities, evolving requirements, and switching
 



 between languages, platforms, and modules.
 



 • AI\-ready working style — treats AI tooling as leverage, prompts and reviews critically, and
 



 understands where generated code needs to be challenged.
 



 • A strong reading and self\-learning habit — follows source code, specifications, and engineering
 



 blogs, and can bring what they read back into the product.
 



 • Working comfort with statistical concepts as applied to time\-series (distributions, seasonality,
 



 percentiles, drift) and the ability to implement a detection algorithm from a specification or paper.
 



 • Ownership and accountability — takes a module from design through production support, raises
 



 risks early, and does not treat a handoff as the end of responsibility

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

****Essential Skills \& Experience****
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


****Desirable Skills \& Experience****
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
**Compensation:**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.

+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

**ABOUT SCRIPT ASSIST** 




 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company building software and operational infrastructure for complex private clinical and pharmacy services.
 



 Our platform:
 



 • Supports tens of thousands of recurring subscriptions each month alongside high\-volume clinical and pharmacy workflows.
 



 • Supports multiple medications, treatment pathways, clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams within one shared platform.
 



 • Covers prescribing, patient onboarding, medication workflows, dispensing, inventory, subscriptions, payments, fulfilment, communications, reporting, permissions and external integrations.

 This is not a prototype or a simple dashboard product. Features interact with permissions, tenant configuration, existing workflows, integrations and production data.
 



 Healthcare experience is not required. Experience building genuinely complex software is.

 • Backend services and business logic using Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript.

 • Automated tests and observability that make production changes safer.
 



**MULTI\-TENANT SAAS EXPERIENCE** 




 Multi\-tenant SaaS experience is a core requirement for this role.
 



 We are looking for candidates who have actually developed a production product used by multiple customer organisations.
 



 You should have experience with:
 



 • A shared product and codebase used by multiple tenants/customers.
 



 • Tenant\-aware data access or isolation.
 



 • Different permissions, roles, configurations or feature access between tenants.
 



 • Customer\-specific behaviour without creating a completely separate product for every client.
 



 • Several interconnected modules, workflows or integrations.
 



 • Production releases where changes needed to remain compatible with existing customers.
 



 Important: Working on multiple separate client projects does not automatically mean you have multi\-tenant SaaS experience. We will ask you to explain how tenancy worked in the product you built.
 



**AI\-FIRST ENGINEERING** 




 We are looking for engineers whose development workflow has materially changed because of AI.
 



 AI should be a regular implementation tool, not something used only occasionally to explain an error.
 



 You will use AI to:
 



 • Understand – Inspect unfamiliar modules, trace code paths and understand existing patterns.
 



 • Plan – Break requirements into implementation steps, identify dependencies and consider edge cases.
 



 • Implement – Generate substantial implementation work rather than manually typing routine code.
 



 • Test – Create and extend unit, integration and edge\-case test coverage.
 



 • Debug – Analyse errors, logs, failing tests and unfamiliar execution paths.
 



 • Verify – Review diffs, run tests and validate behaviour yourself.
 



 AI output is never accepted blindly. You remain accountable for the quality, correctness and maintainability of your work.
 



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




 • 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience.
 



 • 2\+ years of hands\-on production Node.js development.
 



 • 2\+ years of production React / React.js development.
 



 • 2\+ years of production TypeScript development.
 



 • Real experience building a multi\-tenant SaaS product.
 



 • Strong understanding of backend business logic, APIs, databases and production debugging.
 



 • Experience owning features end\-to\-end rather than only implementing small isolated tickets.
 



 • Clear written and spoken English.
 



 • Strong AI\-assisted engineering experience across planning, implementation, testing and debugging.
 



**NICE TO HAVE** 




 • NestJS, Express or Fastify.
 



 • PostgreSQL, MongoDB or another production database.
 



 • Redis, queues, background jobs or event\-driven processing.
 



 • REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks and third\-party integrations.
 



 • Docker, CI/CD and cloud environments.
 



 • RBAC, permissions, feature flags and tenant configuration.
 



 • Testing, logging, monitoring and production incident investigation.
 



 We do not require experience with one particular cloud, database or queue technology. We care more about the quality and complexity of the systems you have actually built.
 



**WHY JOIN SCRIPT ASSIST?** 




 • Build on a live multi\-tenant SaaS platform where your work reaches real customers quickly.
 



 • Work across backend and frontend rather than being confined to one narrow subsystem.
 



 • Take meaningful end\-to\-end ownership of features and workflows.
